newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Quake shakes northern Israel, no one hurt.
newsitem.headline: Quake shakes northern Israel, no one hurt.

text.p: An earthquake rocked northern Israel on Thursday but Israeli radio stations said there were no injuries or serious damage.
Avi Shapira, director of Israel's Geophysical Institute seismology branch, told Israel Radio it was a "weak" quake measuring 3.6 on the Richter scale.
He said it was felt in Israel's northern Galilee and parts of southern Lebanon.
Residents of Kiryat Shmona and other parts of northern Israel told the radio their houses shook and they felt the earth move.
